content: Mathlib has docs#TopCat.Presheaf.restrict, but, e.g., docs#TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq and some other lemmas don't use it. Should I migrate these lemmas to use restrict?
I don't think we should be using docs#TopCat.Presheaf.restrict at all, it just introduces one more way to spell something. We can consider adding notation for F.map (homOfLE h).op x if really needed.
CC: @Kim Morrison You're listed as the primary author in both files.
I have very little experience with the category theory / algebraic geometry part of Mathlib, so I have no opinion here, other than we should choose a normal form and use it everywhere.
I would agree with @Christian Merten here.
Unless someone objects, I'll turn restrict into notation later tonight

I have trouble writing notation that works without an auxiliary definition, and I'm worried that an aux definition (even an abbrev) will get in the way of tactics (I saw examples of simp not unfolding docs#ContinuousLinearMap.det).
